user.title: Set up Home Daily Report
user.description: Track selected entities, generate daily rollups, and optionally summarize them with the external Gemini sidecar.

data_description.included_device_ids: Optional. Leave empty to track all matching entities in the selected domains.
data_description.included_entity_ids: Optional. Select helper entities or any specific entities to always include.
data_description.excluded_device_ids: Optional. Exclude every entity belonging to these devices. Exclusions always win.
data_description.excluded_entity_ids: Optional. Exclude these exact entities. Exclusions always win.
data_description.excluded_entity_globs: Comma-separated entity glob patterns, such as sensor.time*,sensor.date*.
data_description.report_time: Local time to generate the daily report.
data_description.max_days: Number of days of rollups to keep.
data_description.notify_service: Enter the existing Home Assistant notification service, such as notify.telegram.
data_description.sidecar_url: Required HTTP(S) base URL of the external analytics sidecar.
data_description.sidecar_token: Required shared token. Never include this token in logs or report attributes.
data_description.gemini_model: Flash is recommended for daily reports; a supported Gemini Pro model is also allowed.

error.invalid_config: Check the sidecar, model, profile, and report-time settings.

abort.already_configured: Home Daily Report is already configured.
